Here is a line-by-line Latin transcription of the historical marriage register entries visible in **image_84774c.png**.

The register is divided into two main sections across the pages, covering the latter part of **1861** and moving into **1862**. Standard Latin genealogical abbreviations (such as *mat. junxi* for *matrimonio junxi*—"I joined in marriage") have been transcribed as written.

---

### Left Column: August 1861 – January 1862

**Augusti 1861**

* **10.** Michaelem Molony & Brigidam Martin junxi testibus Coram Patricio Martin et Maria Cronin. J. Clifford
* **Sept. 24.** Joannem Scully & Helenam Lee matrimonio junxi et Coram Jacobo Flaherty & Marg.a Conway. J. Roche
* **15.** Michaelem Cagney & Brig. McGarry mat. junxi Coram Joanne White & Helena Quinlan. J. Roche
* **23.** Eduardum Allen & Frances Lyman præst. Coram Jacobo Ladd & Anna Lyman. J. Quinlan
* **27.** Eduardum Kennedy et Brigidam Whelan mat. junxi Coram Eduardo Carroll & Maria Molony. J. L. Roche V.G.
* **29.** Patricium Moriarty et Joannam Gorman mat. junxi Coram Eugenio Gorman & Anastasia Blake. J. L. Roche
* **Octobris 5.** Danielem Hayes et Cath. Allen cum licentia Parochi mat. junxi Coram Patricio Allen & Maria Clanchy. J. L. Roche V.G.
* **24.** Michaelem Cagney et Mariam Tracy cum licentia Parochi mat. junxi Coram Joanne Whyte & Helena Houlihan. J. L. Roche
* **26.** Jacobum Connoctine & Mariam Griffin mat. junxi cum licentia Parochi. Coram Michaele Neville & Maria Clanchy
* **28.** Patricium Hayes et Mariam Allen mat. junxi Coram Michaele Rahilly & Maria Burns. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Nov. 10.** Joannem Kennedy & Mariam Kean mat. junxi Coram Gulielmo Molony & Catharina Devany. Joannes Quinlan C.C.
* **12.** Jacobum Veale & Brigidam Hickey mat. junxi Coram Michaele Rahilly & Cath. Clanchy. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **17.** Patricium Enright & Cath. Hellinan mat. junxi Coram Joanne Ryan & Maria Hegarty. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **[--].** Michaelem Grady & Margaritam Lee mat. junxi Coram Joanne Scully & Maria Lillis. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 25a Januarii 1862.** – Joannem Butler de vide Reverend Jacob O'Rorke P.P. Patrick Well – et Margaritam O'Brien de mea cura & Croom. Coram Patricio Flaherty et Anna Butler Joannes Quinlan P.P.
